Neftochimic 1986 was a Bulgarian association football club based in Burgas. The club participated in the A Group, the first tier of Bulgarian football. Neftochimic was founded in 2009 and was claimed that is the official successor of the traditions and successes of the disbanded Naftex Burgas, which was founded in 1962.
